name: Cubiczan CHP Workup
description: Shared ServiceSell + FinBridge tools: ingest, workup, CHP lock, export. Deterministic JSON-RPC; no network.
_comment: tool_id is the local/dev placeholder used by anna-app dev (uvx / stdio). Publish mints a platform tool_id and substitutes bundled:cubiczan-chp. Do not commit minted ids such as tool-cubiczan-cubiczan-chp-yexs252k. linux-x86_64 is required for Anna Cloud Agent. Download GHA Release archives into this executa's dist/ before anna-app apps publish. Flip distribution.active to local only for laptop-only pushes that skip binaries.
